purpose: Host navigation, registered workbench surfaces, context inspection, shared output and active-surface status without assuming a database model.
navigation_model: The selected registered activity owns the navigator; changing it never replaces the active workbench surface.

states.default: Registered activities and the active surface are operable.
states.loading: The requested navigator or surface retains its host and exposes restrained progress.
states.empty: The active registered host explains that no contribution is available.
states.error: Platform or surface restoration failure is shown with its recovery path.
states.permission: Unauthorized contributions are omitted and direct invocation remains denied.
states.disconnected_or_stale: Status explicitly names a disconnected session or stale resource binding.

keyboard: Activity controls, splitters, tabs, drawer, inspector and surface controls are reachable in document order; splitters use arrows and Shift+arrows.
pointer: Splitters resize; registered surface tabs dock/detach through WorkspaceHost; every drag action retains a command/button alternative.
persistence: Device-local schema-versioned geometry only; no resource content, query text or credentials.
multi_window: ToolDescriptor and WorkspaceHost control detach/restore capabilities per surface.
accessibility: All regions have persistent accessible names and profile-controlled geometry.
